Name: Acchi wa Kocchi
Description: 'The film fuses live action and animation and was screened at Three-Person Animation 2. Musique concrète and electronic sounds made by modulating everyday noises such as flush toilets are interspersed throughout the work. Contrasts between opposites, as encapsulated by the title – between live-action space and animated space, between mundane sounds of daily life and bizarre noises – and the war between the sexes, a signature theme in Yoji Kuri’s work, are also palpable in the juxtaposition of musique concrète and scat singing.'

Name: Anju to Zushiou Maru
Tags: Adventure, Drama, Feudal Japan, Forest, Historical, Magic, Melancholy, Siblings, Based on a Novel
Description: An officer is falsely accused of setting on fire a forest he was supposed to protect. While he is under trial in Kyoto, his family receives an order to leave their mansion and to surrender to the new owner of the land. The family flees, but they end up being tricked and separated by bandits. Sold as slaves, the two children start living a bitter new reality where they must struggle to survive doing harsh physical labor. Anju and her younger brother Zushio try to protect each other as they wonder if they will ever see their parents again.
